title_sq: Cmim Okazion! Tek Stacioni I Trenit, Shitet Super Apartament 4+1, I Pershtatshem Dhe Per Biznes!
description_sq: Cmim Okazion! Ne Nje Nga Zonat Elitare Te Tiranes, Tek Stacioni I Trenit Shitet Apartament 4+1, E pershtatshme Dhe Per Biznes !! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 1 te nje pallati 7 katesh dhe ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 199.7m². Apartamenti organizohet ne nje korridor qe ndan ambientet ne hapsiren e ndenjes me dalje ne ballkon, 1 dhome e parashikuar per gatim ngrenie me vete, por qe lehtesisht bashkohet me pjesen e ndenjes per ata qe e preferojne te tille, 3 dhomat e gjumit dhe dy tualete. Apartamenti ka hapesira te bollshme dhe orientim Perendim. Objekti eshte nje godine 7 kateshe dhe me 2 kate nentokesore per parkim momentalisht ne faze shtrimi me pllake dhe pritet te mbaroi deri ne fund te vitit . Ndertimi do te jete mjaft cilesor sipas parametrave me te fundit te ndertimeve. Zona ku ndodhet eshte mjaft e preferuar dhe me shume facilitete prane. Eshte vetem pak metra larg nga Unaza e vogel e Tiranes
title_en: Bargain price! Near the train station, super apartment 4+1 for sale, suitable for business!
description_en: Bargain price! In one of the elite areas of Tirana, near the train station, a 4+1 apartment for sale, suitable for business!! The apartment is located on the 1st floor of a 7-story building and has a total area of ​​199.7m². The apartment is organized in a corridor that separates the rooms in the living area with access to the balcony, 1 room designed for self-catering, but which can easily join the living room for those who prefer it, 3 bedrooms and two bathrooms. The apartment has ample spaces and West orientation. The building is a 7-story building with 2 underground floors for parking, currently in the paving phase and is expected to be finished by the end of the year. The construction will be of high quality according to the latest construction parameters. The area where it is located is very popular and has many facilities nearby. It is only a few meters away from the small Ring of Tirana
